title: Establish Archivist regression and smoke test harness
goal: Create a durable local regression and smoke test harness for Archivist service contracts, desktop browser behavior, document rendering coverage, and future review/edit workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Define local commands for service endpoint smoke, frontend build, desktop browser smoke, and screenshot/evidence capture
Cover both fast fixture checks against epp-seed and parity checks against epp-full where appropriate
Include regression coverage for navigation completeness, direct document URLs, service-unavailable state, representative document rendering, and key placeholder/artifact fallback behavior
Provide a path for expanding into renderer parity samples, workbook flows, proposal/review flows, and history/audit checks as those features land
Document when tests are expected to run locally before handoff and what evidence should be captured
non_goals: Blocking SG-0013 on the full regression harness
Pixel-perfect visual regression for every document
External tracker sync or cloud-only CI as the first test path
validation: Run the documented local smoke/regression command set once the harness exists
notes: Created from prep agreement that SG-0013 should have repeatable desktop smoke, while broader regression coverage should live as its own future quality-infrastructure slice rather than bloating the browser-shell build.
